label: LinkedIn
what: Your posts and their numbers, from LinkedIn's own data export. A file import, not a live feed.
reads: The posts file from your own data export (Shares.csv, or the .zip).
An optional post analytics file in the same folder, for impressions, reactions and comments.
not_reads: Messages, connections and anything else in the export.
Anything newer than the export you dropped.
scopes: None. There is no login and no network call. It reads files in one folder.
steps: On linkedin.com open Settings, then Data privacy, then Get a copy of your data.
Choose Posts and request the archive. LinkedIn emails you when it is ready.
Download it and put Shares.csv, or the whole .zip, in ~/Documents/quarterdeck-inbox/linkedin/
Optional: export per-post analytics as CSV or XLSX and put it in the same folder.
Switch LinkedIn on. It shows your latest 8 posts and updates when you drop new files.
revoke: Delete the files from ~/Documents/quarterdeck-inbox/linkedin/ and switch LinkedIn off. There is nothing to revoke at LinkedIn.
tested: Parsing tested against sample data only; not tested against the real service.
